name: reflectron-off-focus
description: Closed form: 2L/v + 2v/a with L = 150 mm, six penetration depths of drift. The same single-stage mirror as the focused reflectron, with the drift lengthened from four penetration depths to six. The flight time is still 2L/v + 2v/a exactly, and it is the *energy focusing* that is gone: dT/dv no longer vanishes, so an energy spread now shows up as an arrival spread at first order rather than second. Run this beside single-stage-reflectron to see what the four-depth condition buys, and note it buys nothing in the flight time itself.
